welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.subtitle: A trusted network for thalassemia patients and blood donors.

auth.forgotPasswordBody: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
auth.resetLinkSent: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way.
auth.noAccount: Don't have an account? Sign up
auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

verifyEmail.title: Check your email
verifyEmail.body: We've sent a confirmation link to your email. Confirm it, then come back and sign in.

onboarding.title: Tell us about you
onboarding.rolesLabel: I am a... (choose all that apply)
onboarding.shareContactLabel: Share my phone number after a donor accepts
onboarding.shareContactHint: If off, contact stays in-app only. You can change this anytime in settings.

donorProfile.title: Donor settings
donorProfile.eligibilityDisclaimer: Eligibility to donate is decided by the blood bank or a doctor.
donorProfile.donationHistoryEmptyDescription: Confirmed donations will show up here.

patients.thalassemiaTypeHint: Voluntary. Only shown to donors if you turn that on below.
patients.visibilityHint: Strangers never see any of this — only donors you've connected with, and only what you allow here.
patients.emptyDescription: Add a patient to start building their donor network.

network.invalidCode: Enter the 8-character code exactly as given.
network.requestSent: Request sent. The family will review it.
network.shareMessage: Join {{name}}'s donor network on Thalassemia Support. Invite code: {{code}}
network.limitHint: You can connect up to {{max}} donors per patient.
network.emptyDescription: Share your patient's invite code, or enter one from a donor's invite.
network.removeConfirmBody: They'll no longer see this patient. This can't be undone, but they can be invited again later.
network.leaveConfirmBody: You'll no longer see this patient's requests. This can't be undone, but you can rejoin with a new invite later.

requests.title: Blood requests
requests.cancelConfirmBody: Donors who haven't responded yet will no longer see it. This can't be undone.
requests.emptyDescription: Create a request when a patient needs blood.
requests.componentHint: As advised by the hospital. The app doesn't decide this.
requests.donorReportedDonated: The donor says they've donated — awaiting your confirmation.
requests.confirmDonationBody: This records that the donation happened and cannot be undone. Only confirm once the donation is actually complete.
requests.withdrawConfirmBody: The family will be notified. There's no penalty for withdrawing.
requests.iDonatedConfirmTitle: Let the family know you donated?
requests.iDonatedConfirmBody: This tells the family you believe you've donated. It is not the final record — they still need to confirm it before it counts as a completed donation.
requests.acceptedNote: You've said you can donate. This isn't a completed donation yet — the family confirms that once it happens.
requests.completedNote: Thank you — this donation has been confirmed.

inbox.emptyDescription: You'll see blood requests here when a connected patient needs your blood group.

wizard.title: Request blood
wizard.disclaimer: This app does not decide how much blood is needed or who is eligible to donate — that's for the hospital and blood bank to advise.

disclaimer.generic: This app does not decide donor eligibility, blood quantity, compatibility, or medical treatment. Always consult a doctor or blood bank for those decisions.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.not_authorized: You are not authorized to do that.
errors.connection_already_exists: You're already connected (or have a pending request) with this patient.
errors.connection_not_found: This connection could not be found.
errors.donor_has_active_commitment: You already have an active commitment on another request.
errors.donor_limit_reached: This patient has reached their maximum number of connected donors.
errors.donor_profile_required: Set up your donor profile first.
errors.duplicate_request: There's already an open request for this patient on that date.
errors.invalid_transition: That action isn't available right now.
errors.invite_code_generation_failed: Couldn't generate an invite code. Try again.
errors.notification_not_found: This notification could not be found.
errors.patient_not_found: This patient could not be found.
errors.profile_not_found: Your profile could not be found.
errors.request_not_found: This request could not be found.
errors.response_not_found: This response could not be found.
errors.email_not_confirmed: Confirm your email before signing in.
errors.user_already_exists: An account with that email already exists.
errors.weak_password: Choose a stronger password (at least 8 characters).
errors.over_email_send_rate_limit: Too many attempts. Wait a bit and try again.
